Package eu.algites.lib.data.dataobject

Annotation Interface AIaDataObjectField

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(METHOD) public @interface AIaDataObjectField
Describes an individual property in a read-only structured data-object contract. Schema-specific metadata such as XML QName and XML attribute/element kind belongs to schema-specific annotations, and human-readable text belongs to AIaFieldLabel.

  • Element Details

    • fieldName

      String fieldName
      Stable unlocalized field identifier independent of its presentation and wire QName. An empty string derives the name from the Java getter.
      Returns:
      schema field identifier or empty for getter-derived naming
      Default:
      ""

    • presence

      AInFieldPresenceKind presence
      Presence restriction enforced by data-object implementations. REQUIRED requires an explicit or effective value, ALLOWED permits absence, and FORBIDDEN rejects assignment.
      Returns:
      field presence policy; ALLOWED by default
      Default:
      ALLOWED

    • allowsNull

      boolean allowsNull
      Whether explicitly assigned null is permitted, independently of absence. A derived contract may narrow this permission but cannot widen a prohibition.
      Returns:
      true unless nullability is explicitly forbidden
      Default:
      true

    • setterInheritancePolicy

      AInFieldSetterInheritancePolicy setterInheritancePolicy
      Declares the inherited setter parameter-type strategy for this field.

      DEFAULT delegates to the containing data object or configured generator default. A resolved generated contract records an effective strategy independent of the generating build's environment. A fixed strategy does not prevent Java method inheritance; it prevents unsafe type narrowing in descendants.

      Returns:
      the setter parameter inheritance strategy, or DEFAULT when this declaration leaves the selection to its context
      Default:
      DEFAULT
